optimization_velocity.recommendation: The playbook has reasonable content coverage for observed failure modes — most reflected failures have an applicable entry. The gap is compliance, not coverage. Future mutations should consider: (1) whether 678183ac's hard-gate format improves compliance over softer guidance, (2) whether consolidating overlapping entries improves salience, (3) exposure of untested entries to relevant scenarios. Track whether the parametric-knowledge pattern recurs — if 678183ac doesn't help, this may be a model capability limit.
